title: UI settings (GET and PUT /api/settings)
description: The UI settings of spec-006 §2 (REQ-STATE-09, C4): the body of GET /api/settings, of the PUT /api/settings request (the whole object, RP-28) and of its 200 answer (spec-004 §3). Global to every project, local to the user's machine, never a secret (REQ-SEC-09). Each property's default is the value read when the key is missing or invalid in state.json.

fetchIntervalSeconds.description: Interval of the scheduler's ticks, in seconds (spec-010 §6, RP-19).

autoUpdate.description: Fast-forward after a successful automatic fetch (spec-010 §6).

autoPush.description: Push after each governed write from the UI (spec-010 §6).

confirmAgentLaunch.description: Stored and shown; takes effect from WingFoil 0.3 (capability agent-launch, RP-15).

actionLogCap.description: Most entries kept in the action log (REQ-SEC-10, RP-26); lowering it trims the oldest entries in the same write (RP-38).
